title: Flix TokenKind Inventory Schema
description: Schema for ast/tokenkind.json, enumerating every lexical token kind reflected from the pinned Flix reference compiler. This is the contract for lexical consumers -- syntax highlighters and TextMate grammars -- which have no parse tree and cannot consume fixtures/expected/.

generatedBy.description: Fully qualified generator that produced this file.

toolVersion.description: Generator version; bumped when output format or selection logic changes.

upstreamCommit.description: flix/flix commit this inventory was derived from.

oracleSha256.description: SHA-256 of the oracle jar actually used.

tokenKindDigest.description: SHA-256 over the sorted token name set.

name.description: Token kind name, e.g. KeywordDef, ParenL, NameLowercase. TokenKind is a flat hierarchy, so names need no qualification and cannot collide.

form.description: JVM representation form, decided by the presence of Scala's MODULE$ field.
